locations.note: Over one day Mark Hammond fights through the London underworld to rescue his kidnapped son Alex, while the Flying Squad officer Frank Carter plays the parallel story.
The Collins Gang's headquarters, where Mark's day begins.
Mark follows the kidnappers' trail to a Triad stronghold in Chinatown.
Mark reaches Charlie Jolson's mansion in Mayfair in the hunt for his son.
The finale takes place on the container ship Sol Vita.

routes.name: Mark Hammond
routes.note: From the Collins Gang's Soho headquarters to the ship at St Saviour's Dock.
